title: Nue's Exorcist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Timid high schooler Gakuro Yajima has seen spirits since childhood, and a malevolent one killed his father. At his new school he meets Nue, a powerful spirit in the form of a young woman sealed in a hidden room for over sixty years. After he is mortally wounded by a violent spirit, he makes a contract with Nue: she lends him her power if he helps her vanquish evil spirits alongside wary local exorcists. Ongoing in Weekly Shonen Jump.
life_message: Courage grows from facing fear to protect others, with trusted partners at your side.
